attributes.title: Choosing a tool for your team
attributes.brief: What do teams weigh most when picking an app builder? We want to know what to lead with, and what is just table stakes.
attributes.prompt: When your team picks a tool to build apps with, which matters more?
attributes.items:
Price
Easy for anyone on the team to use
Looks good
Works with the tools we already use
Our data stays private
Can be shaped exactly to how we work
Up and running in a day
The company will still be around in five years
